capture.required_execution: visible Vulkan Forward+; headless is unsupported because GDGS draw completion does not arrive reliably

stitch.mapping: longitude wraps horizontally; -Z is center, +X is right quarter, -X is left quarter, +Z is wrap seam, +Y/-Y are poles
stitch.sampling: bilinear RGB sampling with half-texel pixel-center convention and face-edge clamp

derivative_chain: One visible Forward+/Vulkan GDGS load and six transient square lossless PNG face captures
Downscaled review panorama and labeled cubemap cross

review.reproducibility_limit: The six full-resolution GPU face PNGs are intentionally omitted to avoid retaining roughly 20 MB of intermediate evidence. Their exact hashes and byte sizes remain in stitch-report.json, but those bytes cannot be reconstructed from hashes. The offline stitch is deterministic for fixed face bytes and pinned versions; a fresh GDGS/GPU capture can vary because device rendering, splat sorting, and driver behavior are not guaranteed byte-deterministic.
